title: Reverse an Array In-Place
description:
Given an integer array `nums`, reverse the elements of `nums` **in-place** so that the first element becomes the last, the second becomes the second-to-last, and so on.

Do not return anything; modify `nums` directly using `O(1)` extra space.
hints: Use two pointers starting at the two ends of the array: `left = 0` and `right = nums.length - 1`.
Swap `nums[left]` and `nums[right]`, then move `left` forward and `right` backward until they meet or cross.

examples.explanation: Swapping symmetric pairs (1 with 5, 2 with 4) leaves 3 in the middle and yields [5, 4, 3, 2, 1].
A single-element array remains unchanged after reversal.
